root_cause.text: A race condition in the MPLS subsystem allows RCU-protected readers to observe an inconsistent snapshot of the `platform_labels` size and `platform_label` pointer during a concurrent table resize, enabling index validation to pass while the underlying array has been resized to a smaller size, resulting in out-of-bounds access.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "RCU-protected codepaths (mpls_forward, mpls_dump_routes) can have an inconsistent view of platform_labels vs platform_label in case of a concurrent resize," and the patch resolves this by adding a `seqcount` (`platform_label_seq`) to synchronize the reading of both the size and pointer fields within the RCU read-side critical section.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes race condition in MPLS route input by introducing seqcount-protected atomic read of platform label array and its size.
intent_record.what: Added new static helper function mpls_platform_label_rcu() that uses seqcount to atomically read platform_label pointer and platform_labels count. Modified mpls_route_input_rcu() to use this helper instead of directly accessing net->mpls.platform_label and net->mpls.platform_labels separately.
intent_record.how: Ensures RCU-safe atomic access to both the platform label array pointer and its size. Prevents race conditions where platform_labels could change between the bounds check and array dereference, eliminating a TOCTOU vulnerability in MPLS route lookup.
